title: Service-Fee Part Priced into Over-Cap Review Amounts, Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
Cartwise Grocery Orders prices a service-fee part onto the over-cap claim value of a line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found. The fee part is added to the over-cap claim value before the missing refund standing on the order is taken off, and it is set by how the order's service fee was billed:

1. When the order carries a service-fee waiver from the member service-fee rate and a Cartwise+ plan is recorded on the order, the fee part is the claim value times the member service-fee rate of that plan (a percentage, as the Cartwise+ Membership plan states it), rounded to the cent.
2. When the order carries no such waiver but a service fee is billed on it, the fee part is the claim value times the service fee billed divided by the order's item subtotal (the sum of its billed item lines), rounded to the cent.
3. Otherwise there is no fee part.

**Records read.** The order's fee waiver entries (a waiver whose basis is the member service-fee rate), its service fee charge entry, its billed item lines, and the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order, whose plan carries the member service-fee rate.

### Condition table

| Member service-fee rate waiver on the order | Cartwise+ plan recorded on the order | Service fee billed | Fee part |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | any | Claim value times the plan's member service-fee rate |
| No | any | Yes | Claim value times service fee billed, divided by item subtotal |
| No | any | No | None |
| Yes | No | any | None |

### Illustrations (hypothetical figures, claim value 20.00)

- A member order whose plan's member service-fee rate is a hypothetical 5 percent and which carries a member service-fee rate waiver: fee part 20.00 times 5 percent, that is 1.00.
- A non-member order billed a service fee of 6.00 on an item subtotal of 80.00: fee part 20.00 times 6.00 divided by 80.00, that is 1.50.
- An order with no member-rate waiver and no service fee billed: no fee part.
